Hi Marissa,

We just submitted a signup form and flagged Redwood as a potential vendor for our regulated inference workloads. MedSecure is evaluating Private/VPC and on-prem options for PHI-handling inference; security and network isolation are must-haves.

Can we schedule a short demo next week to see the Private deployment and discuss networking, KMS integration, and audit logs? Ideally a 45-minute session with my engineering lead (CC'd). We are in PST (SF).

Thanks,

Hi Emma — great to meet you and thanks for the signup.

We'd love to run a 45-minute Private/VPC demo focused on:
- Architecture overview (VPC, on-prem options)
- KMS/HSM integrations and key management patterns
- Audit logs and SOC2 evidence collection
- Deployment timelines and next steps for a pilot

I have availability next week on:
- Wed 6/3: 9:30–11:00am or 2:00–4:00pm PT
- Thu 6/4: 10:00–11:30am PT

If any of those work, I can send a calendar invite and loop in our solutions engineer (Rishi) and our AE/renewals lead (Laura) for the procurement/contract discussion.

Also attaching a short architecture diagram and SOC2 summary for pre-read.
